# EduResearch Matters

> A platform for Australian educational researchers to share evidence-based insights on contemporary challenges in education policy, practice, and institutional reform.

EduResearch Matters is the official blog of the Australian Association for Research in Education (AARE), providing a space for researchers to engage with public audiences on critical education topics including inclusive systems, teacher support, Indigenous equity, and the impact of emerging technologies on learning.

## Key Topics

- Educational research
- Education policy
- Inclusive education
- Teacher workload
- Evidence-based policy
- Australian education
- Gifted education
- AI in education
- Indigenous supervision
- Higher education equity
- NAPLAN assessment
- Gender and academia
- School systems
- Public engagement
- AARE

## Getting Started

- [EduResearch Matters - A voice for Australian Educational Researchers](https://blog.aare.edu.au): Homepage for AARE's EduResearch Matters blog platform
- [About this blog - EduResearch Matters](https://blog.aare.edu.au/about-this-blog): Overview of EduResearch Matters blog mission and purpose
- [About AARE - EduResearch Matters](https://blog.aare.edu.au/about-aare): Information about Australian Association for Research in Education

## Featured Research Articles

- [Inclusion isn't failing but our systems are. Here's what we must do now](https://blog.aare.edu.au/inclusion-isnt-failing-but-our-systems-are-heres-what-we-must-do-now): Article on inclusive education systems by David Roy and David Armstrong
- [Putting strong evidence to good use](https://blog.aare.edu.au/putting-strong-evidence-to-good-use): Article on evidence-based education policy and scientific integrity
- [Do we still need expertise now we have AI? We can find out together](https://blog.aare.edu.au/do-we-still-need-expertise-now-we-have-ai-we-can-find-out-together): Article by Shaun Bell on AI literacy and expertise in education
- [Teacher workload's a problem. What is the solution?](https://blog.aare.edu.au/teacher-workloads-a-problem-what-is-the-solution): Research article on teacher workload management and support solutions
- [In a public school classroom, talent won't grow by accident - teachers need more](https://blog.aare.edu.au/in-a-public-school-classroom-talent-wont-grow-by-accident-teachers-need-more): Article by Carla Trott on gifted education and teacher investment

## Contemporary Education Issues

- [Will the social media ban impact NAPLAN results?](https://blog.aare.edu.au/will-the-social-media-ban-impact-naplan): Analysis of social media ban policy impact on NAPLAN assessment outcomes
- [Racism: those of us with institutional power must now respond with honesty not defensiveness](https://blog.aare.edu.au/racism-those-of-us-with-institutional-power-must-now-respond-with-honesty-not-defensiveness): Article on institutional racism and anti-racism responses in education
- [What happens when students weaponise feedback against women academics?](https://blog.aare.edu.au/what-happens-when-students-weaponise-feedback-against-women-academics): Article on gender-based targeting of women academics in higher education
- [Why we need cross-institutional Indigenous supervision reform now](https://blog.aare.edu.au/why-we-need-cross-institutional-indigenous-supervision-reform-now): Article on Indigenous HDR supervision equity and academic recognition
- [As universities are slashed, this is what we need more than ever](https://blog.aare.edu.au/as-universities-are-slashed-this-is-what-we-need-more-than-ever): Article on interdisciplinary research and university funding challenges
